project.title: Integrated Wellbeing Program for At-Risk Youth Group Home
project.objective: Design and pilot a structured wellbeing and social development program for at-risk youths in a group home setting, aligning care, pedagogy, and vocational skills.
deliverables: Structured weekly activity schedule for youths (education, leisure, skills)
Individual support and development plans template for each youth
Crisis and trauma-support response guideline for staff
Vocational skills taster module plan (3–4 short modules)
Staff coordination and handover checklist for shifts
Monitoring framework with simple wellbeing and engagement indicators
constraints: Program must comply with child welfare and safeguarding regulations
Activities must be feasible with existing staff and facilities
Documentation must be simple enough for all shifts to use consistently
Youth participation must be voluntary and non-stigmatizing
Pilot must run within one school term with minimal disruption to routines

risks.risk: Low engagement from youths in planned activities
risks.mitigation: Co-design activities with youths, offer choices, gather quick feedback weekly and adjust.

risks.risk: Staff inconsistency in applying new guidelines and checklists
risks.mitigation: Provide short briefings per shift, keep tools simple, assign a staff champion per shift.

risks.risk: Program conflicts with external schooling or therapy schedules
risks.mitigation: Map all external commitments first and schedule around fixed times; coordinate with external providers.

risks.risk: Emotional overload when addressing trauma-related topics
risks.mitigation: Include clear escalation steps, boundaries, and debrief options for staff; avoid triggering content.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures activities and plans are meaningful, respectful, and increase engagement.
Many youths have trauma or disabilities; program must be safe and inclusive.
Multiple staff rotate; handovers must keep support consistent for each youth.
Need predictable routines while allowing individual needs and crises to be handled.
Vocational elements help youths see options beyond the group home.
Need simple indicators to track progress without overwhelming staff or youths.

backlog.task: Map current weekly routines, obligations, and informal activities of youths
definition_of_done: At least one full week of current routines documented for all youths
Conflicts and free time slots identified
Summary shared in channel and validated by social pedagogue

backlog.task: Design template for individual support and development plans
definition_of_done: Template includes wellbeing, social skills, education, and risk indicators
Sections are understandable for all staff
Template reviewed by vocational teacher and child care worker
Uploaded and linked in channel

backlog.task: Draft structured weekly activity schedule for pilot group
definition_of_done: Schedule covers education support, leisure, and social skills blocks
Takes into account constraints from T1
Includes at least one co-designed youth activity per week
Approved by group home manager

backlog.task: Create crisis and trauma-support response guideline for staff
definition_of_done: Guideline includes early warning signs, de-escalation steps, and escalation paths
Aligned with safeguarding requirements
Reviewed by youth welfare officer
Shared and briefly presented to team

backlog.task: Develop vocational skills taster module plan
definition_of_done: 3–4 short modules defined (e.g., basic cooking, CV basics, workshop skills)
Each module has objectives, duration, and required materials
Activities adapted to different ability levels
Schedule options proposed to fit around school times

backlog.task: Co-design at least two activities with youths
definition_of_done: Youth ideas collected in at least one group discussion
Two activities documented with goals and rules
Activities integrated into weekly schedule
Youths informed of final plan

backlog.task: Create staff coordination and handover checklist for shifts
definition_of_done: Checklist covers key info: mood, incidents, plan updates, appointments
Tested in at least two handovers and refined
Printed or digitally accessible at handover point

backlog.task: Define simple wellbeing and engagement monitoring framework
definition_of_done: 2–4 indicators selected (e.g., participation, mood, conflicts)
Simple rating scale agreed
Recording frequency defined
Framework validated with child care worker team

backlog.task: Pilot vocational taster sessions with small youth group
definition_of_done: At least one session per module delivered
Attendance recorded
Short feedback collected from youths and staff
Adjustments for next cycle documented

backlog.task: Train staff on new tools (plans, checklist, guideline) in short briefings
definition_of_done: Brief talking points prepared
At least two shifts briefed
Questions and concerns captured and answered in channel

backlog.task: Collect and summarize first 2 weeks of pilot feedback
definition_of_done: Feedback from youths and staff gathered (informal or forms)
Key themes and issues summarized in one page
Proposed adjustments listed and shared

backlog.task: Adjust schedule and guidelines based on pilot feedback
definition_of_done: At least three concrete adjustments implemented
Updated documents uploaded
Changes communicated in channel and at handover

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current routines, constraints, and select pilot group for the program.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing project and asking for input on current routines and suitable youths.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on which youths will be included in the first pilot group.
Confirm the time windows available for structured activities on weekdays.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalize the weekly structured activity schedule and co-designed activities.
threads_plan.trigger: Social pedagogue shares first draft of weekly schedule and asks for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the initial weekly structured activity schedule for the pilot.
Select at least two youth co-designed activities to include in the schedule.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on templates and tools: individual plans, handover checklist, and monitoring log.
threads_plan.trigger: Upload of draft templates and request for quick review from all roles.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the Individual Support and Development Plan template for use.
Agree on final version of the shift handover checklist and monitoring indicators.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and coordinate vocational skills taster modules within the weekly schedule.
threads_plan.trigger: Vocational teacher posts proposed modules and asks for timing and group size confirmation.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which vocational modules will run in the first pilot cycle.
Agree on days and times for vocational sessions that do not clash with school or therapy.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review first two weeks of pilot, discuss incidents, and agree on adjustments.
threads_plan.trigger: Social pedagogue posts pilot feedback summary and invites comments and change proposals.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm or adjust the composition of the pilot group based on early experience.
Decide which co-designed activities to keep, modify, or replace after feedback.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in on previous day incidents and mood trends (short notes).
Weekly planning post to confirm activities, responsibilities, and any schedule changes.
Mid-pilot review message summarizing monitoring data and quick wins.
Post-incident debrief thread when a crisis occurs, referencing the crisis guideline.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and next steps.
